definitions.explanation: Describes an object manufactured from porcelain, a hard, white, translucent ceramic fired at high temperatures. Used as a noun modifier to indicate the material of tableware, decorative items, and other objects.

examples.japanese: この{茶碗|ちゃわん}は{磁器|じき}{製|せい}だ。
examples.english: This teacup is made of porcelain.

examples.japanese: {磁器|じき}{製|せい}の{花瓶|かびん}は{割|わ}れやすいので{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Porcelain vases are fragile and require care.

examples.japanese: {有田焼|ありたやき}は{日本|にほん}を{代表|だいひょう}する{磁器|じき}{製|せい}の{食器|しょっき}で、{海外|かいがい}でも{高|たか}く{評価|ひょうか}されている。
examples.english: Arita ware is a representative Japanese porcelain tableware that is also highly regarded overseas.

notes:
A compound of {磁器|じき} (porcelain) and {製|せい} (made of, manufactured from). The suffix {製|せい} is productive and attaches to many materials: {木製|もくせい} (wooden), {金属製|きんぞくせい} (metal), {革製|かわせい} (leather), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磁器|じき}{製|せい}の{食器|しょっき}: porcelain tableware
- {磁器|じき}{製|せい}の{人形|にんぎょう}: porcelain doll
- {磁器|じき}{製|せい}の{花瓶|かびん}: porcelain vase
- {磁器|じき}{製|せい}のタイル: porcelain tile

JAPANESE PORCELAIN:
- {有田焼|ありたやき}: Arita ware (Saga Prefecture)
- {九谷焼|くたにやき}: Kutani ware (Ishikawa Prefecture)
- {伊万里焼|いまりやき}: Imari ware (Saga Prefecture)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {陶器|とうき}{製|せい}: made of earthenware/pottery — {陶器|とうき} is softer and more porous than {磁器|じき}
- {陶磁器|とうじき}: ceramics — the collective term for both pottery and porcelain
- {瀬戸物|せともの}: ceramic ware — a colloquial term for ceramics in general
